title: Wildcat Protocol V2 (Ethereum + Plasma) — borrower-controlled undercollateralised credit; no unprivileged path
closed_reasons: Wildcat V2 markets are immutable; borrow/close/rescue/setTerms are onlyBorrower, setProtocolFeeBips is factory-only

The only permissionless calls that move the market asset are collectFees (pays the immutable feeRecipient) and executeWithdrawal (pays the named account / its sanctions escrow) — no redirect, fork-proven
The 'borrower-controlled terms' are the intended design (project Known Issues: a malicious borrower can hurt lenders; markets are only deployable by arch-controller-registered borrowers)
Accounting is internal (scaleFactor advanced only by interest/delinquency, conversions floor) so donation / share-inflation attacks do not exist

Shared infra is role-gated: HooksFactory.deployMarket requires isRegisteredBorrower; ArchController is Ownable; FeeRecipient.releaseERC20Fees is recipient/owner-only; sanctions escrow releaseEscrow only pays the account
Plasma markets: Rhinofi (0x9A0B) holds $17,361.47 with depositRequiresAccess + minimumDeposit 1000 USDT0; seve1 (0x74C7) holds $0; Wintermute (0xFf60) and USDT0USDT0 (0xa460) are closed

The v2-protocol repo bytecode comparison may differ from the deployed commit; the authoritative source is the explorer-verified deployed bundle (read directly)
H-O figure is the sum of assets currently held by markets (redeemable by lenders subject to borrower repayment), not extractable by an attacker
P figure is the Plasma market asset the borrower is entitled to borrow (borrowableAssets), not attacker-extractable
All work read-only; PoC executed only on an in-memory fork in GitHub Actions
one_liner: Wildcat V2 exposes $0 to an external unprivileged attacker on Ethereum and Plasma: every value path is onlyBorrower, pays the named account, or pays the fee recipient; the 'borrower-controlled terms' are the intended (H-O/P) design, fork-proven with 15 tests.
